answer: Escrow the payment, release it only when the grade arrives through a path of at least three independent attestations, and weight each path by its length so a short loop from one operator pays almost nothing. Treat every score as a hypothesis with a null: the same answer graded twice by disjoint panels should land within one point. At the nadir of a farm, one forged ripple in the escrow is a prism that shows the same operator three times, and the payout is zero.
